The Vanilla line ends at approximately 2.45, not 2.60–2.62.

errors.evidence: The StrmLLM (n=64) line is shown in blue, not dark blue, and the Vanilla line is incorrectly labeled as light blue (already flagged), while StrmLLM is a distinct blue.
The SepLLM (n=64) line ends closer to 2.52, but the range 2.52–2.53 is a minor overstatement.

errors.text_span: ending at a similar value near 2.52–2.53
errors.evidence: The SepLLM (n=64, H) line ends near 2.51, not 2.52–2.53.
The SepLLM (n=64, H/T) line ends near 2.49, not 2.52–2.53.
The SepLLM (n=128) line is depicted in a blue-violet color, not dark navy/black.
The SepLLM (n=128) line ends just above 2.5, closer to 2.50–2.51, not 2.51–2.53.

errors.text_span: The four SepLLM variants cluster closely together and consistently achieve lower loss values than the Vanilla and StrmLLM lines throughout training.
